By enabling operators to strategically place cell towers based on precise topographical and seasonal data, the tool aims to ensure optimal 5G coverage across the UK from launch.

Conversely, Labour warns that scrapping the board will trigger a race to the bottom in wages and benefits, ultimately eroding the financial security of vulnerable workers.

reference: The Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors national parks have been designated Dark Sky Reserves.

Spanning a combined 3,500 square kilometers, this joint designation makes it one of Europe's largest simultaneous dark sky reserves and expands the UK's network of protected night-time environments.
